false_architectural_split_analysis.true_false_splits: Cannot be reliably calculated from the current proposal inventory without final candidate selection
false_architectural_split_analysis.explanation: At the proposal generation stage, redundant or low-IoU candidate polygons do not represent true false splits (i.e. splitting a single logical room into multiple final detected rooms). The 4,478 unselected proposals consist of duplicates (1,556), low-quality/sliver geometry (1,501), and redundant hypotheses (1,462).
